objectives.text: It is the policy of Congress that the Rural Electrification Administration make loans that facilitate the development and enhancement of the rural telecommunications infrastructure in order to make modern telecommunications technology and services available at reasonable rates to the greatest practicable number of people in rural areas in the United States.

citations.quote: It is the policy of the Congress that the Rural Electrification Administration make loans that facilitate the development and enhancement of the rural telecommunications infrastructure in order to make modern telecommunications technology and services available at reasonable rates to the greatest practicable number of people in rural areas in the United States.

objectives.text: Congress finds that making modern telecommunications technology and services available in rural areas promotes economic development and improves quality of life, and that efficient operation of the Rural Telephone Bank and the REA telephone loan programs is essential to continued development of rural telecommunications infrastructure.

citations.quote: making modern telecommunications technology and services available in rural areas in the United States promotes economic development and improves the quality of life in rural areas

the efficient operation of the Rural Telephone Bank and the Rural Electrification Administration telephone loan programs is essential to the continued development of the telecommunications infrastructure in rural areas in the United States.

notes: This section (7 U.S.C. 901) is itself only the short-title provision ('This chapter may be cited as the "Rural Electrification Act of 1936"'); the substantive scope-relevant content extracted here comes from the accompanying Statutory Notes (Findings; Statement of Policy, and the Regulations note under Pub. L. 103-129) reproduced in the source text. The operative loan-program rules reside in other sections of the chapter (e.g., 902, 935, 936) referenced but not set out here. The Findings/Statement of Policy and Regulations obligations are historical statutory notes tied to 1990 and 1993 enactments; the text presents them as reproduced in the current edition ('Text contains those laws in effect on July 22, 2026') without indicating repeal of these particular notes, so they are extracted as written. The Rural Telephone Bank referenced in the 1990 policy note was subsequently repealed (2018) per a bracketed editorial note — an internal tension preserved as written.
